questions.stem: The probability of rain on any day is $0.3$ (independent). Using a tree diagram for two consecutive days, what is the probability it rains on both days?
Using the same scenario ($P(\text{rain}) = 0.3$ each day, independent), what is the probability it rains on at least one of the two days?
questions.explanation: $P(\text{no rain both days}) = 0.7 \times 0.7 = 0.49$. $P(\text{at least one day of rain}) = 1 - 0.49 = 0.51$.
